# Inter

The app's typeface: Inter by The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter), from Google Fonts
(`ofl/inter/Inter[opsz,wght].ttf`), used under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt` here, also shipped in
the app as `res/raw/inter_license.txt` and shown in Settings → Credits).

Static instances were made from the variable font with fontTools (`varLib.instancer`, opsz 14) at weights 400,
500, 600 and 700: `app/src/main/res/font/inter_{regular,medium,semibold,bold}.ttf`. The font is not sold on its own.
